This '''six-legged mammal''' was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], making its home in mountain burrows. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], one of these creatures attacked a group of stranded [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the [[Takara Mountains|Cetajan Mountains]], ripping apart one of their wounded before being killed.
